name: move
summary: Moves the drone one tile in a direction. At an edge it comes out on the other side.

name: harvest
summary: Harvests the crop under the drone. A ripe crop adds its items to your bank.

name: plant
summary: Plants a crop on the tile under the drone and pays its seed items.

name: ripe
summary: Tells whether the crop under the drone is ripe.

name: till
summary: Turns grass into soil, or soil into grass. A crop on the tile is removed.

name: ground
summary: Tells which ground is under the drone: GRASS or SOIL.

name: NORTH
summary: A direction for move(). EAST, SOUTH and WEST are the others.

name: EAST
summary: A direction for move().

name: SOUTH
summary: A direction for move().

name: WEST
summary: A direction for move().

name: GRASS
summary: A kind of ground. Compare it with ground().

name: SOIL
summary: A kind of ground. Compare it with ground().

name: CLOVER
summary: A crop that grows wild on every tile. harvest() gives it.

name: RADISH
summary: A crop you plant on grass.

name: POTATO
summary: A crop you plant on soil.

name: for
summary: Repeats the lines inside it a fixed number of times.

name: while
summary: Repeats the lines inside it as long as a condition is true.

name: if
summary: Runs the lines inside it only when a condition is true. else is part of it, and so is elif (Python) or else if (JavaScript).

name: def
summary: Gives a few lines a name, so you can run them with one call.
Compares two values. Python writes == and !=, JavaScript writes === and !==.
